title: MobCap HUD
description: MobCap HUD is a lightweight client side Fabric mod for popular Minecraft Fabric versions. In singleplayer, it renders a compact overlay showing each spawn group's current population, calculated mob cap, and percentage fullness. The HUD is useful for check
body:
MobCap HUD displays a real-time overlay showing the current mob count versus the mob cap for each spawn category, monsters, creatures, ambient, water mobs, axolotls, and more.

Features

Live HUD showing mob count / cap for all spawn groups
Fully configurable via in-game settings (ModMenu support included)
Toggle the HUD on/off with a keybind (default: H)
Adjustable position, scale, and background opacity
Cloth Config bundled, no extra dependencies needed

Why use it?
Whether you're optimizing a farm, debugging spawn issues, or just curious about what's happening under the hood, MobCap HUD gives you the information you need without leaving the game.
Compatibility

Minecraft 1.21.11
Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.2
Fabric API required
